opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK Office (deadline 15 September 2026)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that can receive grant funds; individuals are not accepted unless they can provide organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for collaborative projects between the UK and Japan across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health (deadline 1 December 2026)

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total for up to three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; practitioners, managers, carers and early‑career health professionals are also encouraged. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan.
opportunities.summary: Awards to support exchanges and collaborations between medical and health professionals in the UK and Japan, covering travel, conference, publication and other project costs.
